# commander_new_ssh_keys (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a **New (NSF) SSH Keys** record by **title** or **UID**.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a classic sshKeys record by title or UID.
data "commander_new_ssh_keys" "example" {
  ssh_keys = "_REPLACE_WITH_RECORD_TITLE_OR_UID_"
}

output "ssh_keys_id" {
  value = data.commander_new_ssh_keys.example.id
}

output "ssh_keys_title" {
  value = data.commander_new_ssh_keys.example.title
}

output "ssh_keys_login" {
  value = data.commander_new_ssh_keys.example.login
}

output "ssh_keys_hostname" {
  value = data.commander_new_ssh_keys.example.hostname
}

output "ssh_keys_port" {
  value = data.commander_new_ssh_keys.example.port
}

output "ssh_keys_passphrase" {
  value     = data.commander_new_ssh_keys.example.passphrase
  sensitive = true
}

output "ssh_keys_public_key" {
  value     = data.commander_new_ssh_keys.example.public_key
  sensitive = true
}

output "ssh_keys_private_key" {
  value     = data.commander_new_ssh_keys.example.private_key
  sensitive = true
}

output "ssh_keys_custom" {
  value     = data.commander_new_ssh_keys.example.custom
  sensitive = true
}

output "ssh_keys_share" {
  value = data.commander_new_ssh_keys.example.share
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ssh_keys` (String) New (NSF) SSH Keys record **title** or **UID** to look up.

### Read-Only

- `custom` (Attributes List) Custom fields stored in the record's `custom` array. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom))
- `folder_location` (String) Folder `path` or `UID` where the record is to be stored.
- `hostname` (String) **Hostname** or **IP address**.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier (UID) of the vault record.
- `login` (String) **Username** or **login** identifier.
- `notes` (String) Note of the record.
- `passphrase` (String, Sensitive) **Passphrase**.
- `port` (String) **Port** (numeric string).
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) **Private key**.
- `public_key` (String, Sensitive) **Public key**.
- `share` (Map of String) Mapping of share permissions for this folder or record. For folders, keys can identify either users (**UID** or **email**) or teams (**UID** or **name**). For records, keys can identify users only (**UID** or **email**). Values specify the permission level: `viewer`, `share-manager`, `content-manager`, `content-share-manager`, or `full-manager`. The owner is implicit and never present in this map; the API rejects owner entries.
- `title` (String) Record title.

<a id="nestedatt--custom"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String) Field label.
- `sensitive` (Boolean) Whether the value should be treated as **sensitive**.
- `type` (String) Keeper field **type** (e.g. `text`, `email`, `secret`).
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Field **value** (JSON-encoded for complex types).
